meta.title: Privacy — GitKittie
meta.description: GitKittie apps are local-first: no accounts, no cloud service, no telemetry. Your files move directly between your device and the git host you own, and GitKittie Mail talks only to your own mail provider.

meta.title: Terms & Conditions — GitKittie
meta.description: The terms of use for the GitKittie apps, GitKittie Folder, GitKittie Tasks, GitKittie Bud and GitKittie Mail — provided as-is, using your own git repositories, mail accounts and providers.
